content.short: Blockchain Payments for Salesforce brings Web3 and blockchain technology to corporate CRM, ERP, and BI.
content.description: Blockchain Payments for Salesforce integrates Web3 and blockchain into corporate CRM, ERP, and BI workflows as a native Salesforce tool. It lets teams use their existing processes to complete transactions, while adding crypto payments as an option. Designed to help expand international sales, it begins with Salesforce and will support additional platforms soon, broadening payment options through Web3 channels without disrupting current workflows.
